notes.confirmed: Health declines during prepaid upkeep; no age-triggered cascade; exclusive automated outputs; numeric oldest-first; migration mints a minimum reserve; upkeep burns ualpha; player audits enforce neglect.
notes.candidate_values: Rates, reserve, dust threshold, block-day convention and repair price are not approved consensus parameters. Reserve=0.5 Alpha and dust=0.01 Alpha are sensitivity inputs.
notes.implementation: Standalone economic model, not production Cosmos code. Accepted edges are explicitly built by scenarios. Unaccepted supply is excluded. Full upkeep purchases use authorized liquid ualpha, not guild tokens.
notes.not_included: Distribution accounting, vesting, combat execution, admission signatures, bank failure, gas timings, claim queues, development upgrade formulas and actual testnet graph export.
notes.audit_curve: The range interpolation table was not supplied. Race experiments use only the supplied exact endpoint ranges (65380 and 1387) with the repository integer difficulty formula. No invented interior table.
